title: BOYNEXTDOOR Lands Fifth Top 10 on Album Sales Chart With ‘HOME’
summary: Plus, Olivia Rodrigo, Angine de Poitrine, Sublime, Bebe Rexha and Keith Urban debut in the top 10.
contentText:
BOYNEXTDOOR notches its fifth top 10-charted project on Billboard ’s Top Album Sales chart as HOME opens at No. 2 on the list dated June 27 with 26,000 copies sold in the United States in the week ending June 18, according to Luminate. That marks the best sales week and the highest-charted project for the pop group.

On the overall Billboard 200 (which blends streams, album sales and track sales to rank the most popular albums of the week), the set bows at No. 16, scoring the act its first top 20-charted album, and sixth entry in total.

Also in the top 10 of the latest Top Album Sales chart, Olivia Rodrigo, Angine de Poitrine, Sublime, Bebe Rexha and Keith Urban all make waves.

Billboard ’s Top Album Sales chart ranks the top-selling albums of the week based only on traditional album sales. The chart’s history dates to May 25, 1991, the first week Billboard began tabulating charts with electronically monitored piece count information from SoundScan, now Luminate. Pure album sales were the sole measurement utilized by the Billboard 200 albums chart through the list dated Dec. 6, 2014, after which that chart switched to a methodology that blends album sales with track equivalent album (TEA) units and streaming equivalent album (SEA) units.

Olivia Rodrigo’s you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love debuts at No. 1 on Top Album Sales, garnering Rodrigo her third leader. The title bows with 273,000 copies sold, marking Rodrigo’s best sales week and the largest sales week by a woman in 2026. Further, of that sum, vinyl sales number 164,000 (a debut at No. 1 on the Vinyl Albums chart), which lands Rodrigo’s her biggest week on vinyl and the largest vinyl sales week of 2026 by a woman.

Angine de Poitrine’s Vol. I and Vol. II albums, initially released in June 2024 and April 2026, respectively, both reach the top 10 for the first time, thanks to their vinyl release on June 12. Vol. II reenters at No. 3 and Vol. I debuts at No. 4, essentially all from vinyl purchases. Both mark the first top 10s for the act.

Sublime lands its highest-charting album ever on Top Album Sales as Until the Sun Explodes debuts at No. 5. The new project is the band’s first album with frontman Jakob Nowell , the son of the late Bradley Nowell, who led the group until his death in 1996. (One other Sublime-associated project has reached the top 10, Sublime With Rome’s Yours Truly , which hit No. 9 in 2011.)

Bebe Rexha collects her highest-charted album ever, and second top 10, on Top Album Sales as Dirty Blonde bows at No. 6. She previously went as high as No. 8 in 2018 with Expectations .

Keith Urban’s flow state starts at No. 7, landing the country star his 10th top 10 on Top Album Sales. It also launches at No. 12 on Top Country Albums, notching Urban his 15th top 40 album on that ranking – the entirety of his charting projects on the tally.

Rounding out the top 10 on Top Album Sales: Michael Jackson’s Thriller falls 5-8, CORTIS’ chart-topping GREENGREEN dips 4-9 and BTS’ former leader ARIRANG descends 7-10.
